title: Claude Code Builds N8n Workflows From One Prompt — Setup Guide
description:
Claude Code can now build complete N8n workflows from a single prompt —
and you can sell these to businesses.

What normally takes 30 minutes of manual node dragging now 
takes  under 5 minutes — just by describing what you need 
in natural language.

Here's the exact setup 👇

✅ Download Cursor — search Claude Code in Extensions, install
✅ Open the n8n-mcp GitHub repo — clone it inside Cursor
✅ Open N8n — grab your API key, paste into Claude Code
✅ Confirm MCP is running — green checkmark appears
✅ Tell it what to build — lead gen, onboarding, invoicing, anything

This MCP gives Claude deep knowledge of n8n's 1,851 
workflow automation nodes — 822 core plus 1,029 community nodes. 

Sell these workflows to businesses or use them for yourself.
